title: Morning Prep & Huddle
short_answer: How the day starts: private brief → prep readiness → huddle → field. The expensive mistakes happen before the first screw when nobody read the packet.
summary: Know where you are going, what is ready, and what is blocked before the trucks roll. Morning Brief is for you and your lead — not a public Slack announcement.
plain_words: Know where you are going, what is ready, and what is blocked before the trucks roll. Your Morning Brief is for you and your lead — it is not a public Slack announcement. If prep is red, fix prep or change the plan; do not invent a third job on the way.
when_to_use: Every production morning before trucks roll
When prep, access, or heat looks wrong on the brief
Lead and ops lead huddle before splitting the crew
prerequisites: Morning Brief available on portal (private — never #operations)
Job Start packet read for today's jobs
stage_line: How we run the day · rhythm

tools.name: Job Start / handoff packet for today's jobs

steps.title: Read the Morning Brief
steps.body: Read the Morning Brief on your phone (portal). Note job, address, access, and any Action Requests.

steps.title: Check prep
steps.body: Material on site or loaded? Scaffold/lift as noted? Heat/cans if finishing? Lock box code current?

steps.title: Huddle
steps.body: Huddle with the lead / GM — who goes where, what "done" means today, what is out of scope.

steps.title: Action Requests
steps.body: Ack Action Requests in the window you were given. Silence is not a plan.

steps.title: Unscheduled work last
steps.body: Unscheduled work goes last unless the ops lead rearranges for a hard stop (inspection, owner walk).

warnings.title: Why this page exists
warnings.body: Rework from "we went to the wrong building" or "heat was never on for mud" costs more than a five-minute brief. Standing-by because prep was fake is a documentation event — see Spotting a Change Order — but the better move is not to create it.

warnings.title: Never #operations
warnings.body: Field brief, huddle summary, route sheet, and prep status are always a side chat or DM. Do not post them to Slack #operations — not for review, not temporarily.

quality_checks.prompt: Prep verified: material, access, heat/cans, lock box
Lead huddle defines done and out-of-scope for the day
Action Requests acknowledged in the given window

common_mistakes.title: Driving without reading the brief
common_mistakes.wrong: Show up at yesterday's address or wrong building
common_mistakes.right: Read Morning Brief before wheels roll

common_mistakes.title: Posting brief to #operations
common_mistakes.wrong: Broadcast huddle or route content to the ops channel
common_mistakes.right: Side chat or DM only — locked GVC rule

common_mistakes.title: Fake prep
common_mistakes.wrong: Start finish coats when heat was never on
common_mistakes.right: Fix prep or change the plan before production
